student_summary.status_message: You pass the represented Stage 1 checks and enter Cardiff's separate international ranking pool. Your official 28-point pre-interview score can be calculated; historical UCAT guidance is not a fixed interview cut-off.
key_points: Your GCSE profile scores 24 / 24 using Cardiff's official eight-GCSE scoring count.
Your cognitive UCAT score is engine-mapped to national decile 10 using shared UCAT Consortium statistics, then mapped to 3 / 3 Cardiff UCAT points.
No Further Education Point is awarded because the profile does not explicitly include HPP, further/higher education achievement or another qualifying additional academic achievement.
Your total official pre-interview score is 27 / 28.
International applicants are ranked separately from Home applicants; raw cognitive UCAT breaks ties between identical 28-point scores.
Your 2650 cognitive UCAT is above the supplied international historical range, giving Strong choice guidance only.
